Donald Trump’s transformation of the Department of Justice will be hard to undo
Political prosecutions are just part of a more radical reinvention

Anyone who has ever worked as a lawyer for Donald Trump makes a bet. There is the possibility that you, too, will run afoul of the law—eight of the president’s lawyers have themselves been indicted. Alternatively, your work might pay dividends.
